title: Perform an Indexer Rolling Restart Safely
objectives: Perform an Indexer Rolling Restart Safely
Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: Inspect healthy membership and at least two available searchable copies before restarting. On cm01 run splunk rolling-restart cluster-peers -searchable true, or use Web.

Advance one tick at a time. Observe draining, stopped, verifying and rejoined phases. Search index=source_logs | stats count while a peer is stopped and after the job completes. Verify one peer at a time and count=3. Automatic maintenance ends with the job.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.

references.purpose: Searchable restart and available copy preflight
Deployer source, target and merge_to_default behavior

checks.label: Completed coordinated operation with actual service transitions
Actual joined peers and searchable bucket coverage

feedback.success: Verified operational state and independent evidence are retained in this isolated attempt.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect current source, service state, operation receipts and replica data.
